description:
Turn a control on or off, or change the key or bucket set for a region. Controls and regions that you leave out stay as they are.

Your organization must have proved that it owns the project. Only one organization at a time can have controls turned on for a project.

**Requires a credential that identifies a user or a service account**: an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope, or an organization-scoped API key that belongs to a user or service account whose organization role can update these controls. The `admin`, `owner` and `primary_owner` roles can. An Admin API key gets a `403` error.

AnthropicBeta.description:
Beta names you can send in the `anthropic-beta` header.

See [Beta headers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) for how to send them and where to find the name a feature needs.

cmek.description: The customer-managed encryption key control. Leave it out to keep the control as it is. Send `cmek`, `storage`, or both.
cmek.title: Cmek

storage.description: The customer-owned storage control. Leave it out to keep the control as it is. Send `cmek`, `storage`, or both.
storage.title: Storage

BetaGoogleManagedProjectDataControls.description: A Google Cloud project's encryption key and storage bucket settings for Claude on Google Cloud's Agent Platform. Your organization has one of these objects for each Google Cloud project that it has proved it owns. You can read and update it, but not create or delete it. Keys and buckets are set for each region. A request's region depends on the Google endpoint it is sent to: `us` is the US multi-region endpoint and the regional endpoint of every location whose name starts with `us-`, `eu` is the EU multi-region endpoint and the regional endpoint of every location whose name starts with `europe-`, `sg` is the `asia-southeast1` regional endpoint, and `global` is the global endpoint, wherever Google serves the request. Anthropic may add regions.

cmek.description: The customer-managed encryption key control: the key in your Google Cloud KMS that is set for each region. It covers the project's requests that name no user profile, or a user profile that has no key of its own for the project.
cmek.title: Cmek

project_number.description: The number of the Google Cloud project that these controls belong to, in decimal.
project_number.title: Project Number

storage.description: The customer-owned storage control: your Cloud Storage bucket that is set for each region. It covers the project's requests that name no user profile, or a user profile that has no bucket of its own for the project.
storage.title: Storage

updated_at.description: When an update last changed a control, or a region's status last changed, in RFC 3339 format. A region that starts or stops reading `suspended`, a change to `last_checked_at` alone, and the removal of a retired entry do not count.
updated_at.title: Updated At
